title: Git ref and artifact object enumeration capabilities
description:
Objective: add the two ABSENT enumeration capabilities that the recovery-window inventory adapters must call, to the shipped observers/stores that already own those boundaries. This is a prerequisite production task created because the capability is missing, NOT a narrowed DoD and NOT a test-owned reimplementation.

MEASURED GAP at 2026-08-09 by architect-d46fcb95, symbol by symbol:
- `GitObserver` (packages/runner/src/scope/scope-contract.ts) declares exactly headCommit(), statusPorcelainV2(), lsFilesTracked(), lsFilesIgnored(), submodulePaths(). There is NO branch or ref enumeration. `grep -rn "for-each-ref|show-ref|--branches|refs/heads|listRefs" packages/runner/src --include=*.ts` (non-test) returns ZERO.
- `ArtifactStore` (packages/runner/src/artifacts/artifact-contract.ts) declares exactly stageArtifact(), verifyArtifact(), deleteArtifact(); `ArtifactFsPort` declares openWrite/write/fsync/close/exists/rename/persistAfterRename/readAll/unlink. There is NO directory listing. `grep -rn "readdir|listObjects|listStaging|scandir" packages/runner/src` returns ZERO outside runtime-entrypoint.test.ts.

Consequently task-0325dcf7ee744123b40cf583230c7b6a's DoD 2 ("Git branches/refs ... artifact objects/staging") currently has nothing to call.

Deliverable, additive only:
1. Extend GitObserver with a bounded ref enumeration (refs with their target commit, covering refs/heads and refs/remotes) implemented in createNodeGitObserver via the existing hermetic runGit helper — same shell:false / bounded maxBuffer / timeout / windowsHide discipline, NUL-framed output, and the existing ScopeObserverError codes for overflow and malformed output. Do not loosen hermeticGitEnvironment.
2. Extend ArtifactFsPort with a bounded directory listing and ArtifactStore with object/staging enumeration over the store's own `<root>/objects/<sha256>` layout, implemented in createNodeArtifactFs / createArtifactStore. An entry whose name is not a valid content address is reported as such, never skipped silently.

Both additions are ENUMERATION ONLY: no new mutation, no new authority, no change to any existing method's behaviour or refusal codes.

NOT in scope: the recovery-inventory contract, coverage protocol, or any inventory adapter (those are task-0325dcf7's children); scheduler rows; deciding adopt/quarantine.

Owned paths: packages/runner/src/scope/scope-contract.ts, packages/runner/src/scope/scope-git.ts, packages/runner/src/artifacts/artifact-contract.ts, packages/runner/src/artifacts/artifact-node-fs.ts, packages/runner/src/artifacts/artifact-store.ts, their focused tests, and the minimal @moe/runner root export wiring.

WARNING measured by the architect: packages/runner/src/index-surface.test.ts pins the EXACT root namespace against a hand-written EXPECTED_EXPORTS list plus a hard-coded `expect(EXPECTED_EXPORTS.length).toBe(116)`. Any new root value export reddens it until transcribed and the count bumped. That file was ALREADY red at 2026-08-09 from an unrelated in-flight task's exports; capture the baseline before editing and attribute per the project's path-attributed-baseline rail.

Consumer (global rail Clause 1): task-0325dcf7ee744123b40cf583230c7b6a's Git/integration and artifact/staging adapter child.

Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test
definitionOfDone: GitObserver declares a bounded ref enumeration and createNodeGitObserver implements it through the existing hermetic runGit helper with shell:false, bounded maxBuffer, explicit timeout and windowsHide, returning each ref with its target commit; hermeticGitEnvironment is unchanged.

ArtifactFsPort declares a bounded directory listing and ArtifactStore exposes object/staging enumeration over its own <root>/objects/<sha256> layout; an entry whose name is not a valid content address is reported with a stable code, never silently skipped.

Overflow, a malformed or truncated git response, an absent directory, and an unreadable entry each refuse with an existing stable code and the layer that refused; a test pins the exact code and layer for every one, and no failure escapes as an uncoded throw.
Enumeration output is deterministic across path separators and locale on Windows, macOS and Linux; ordering is canonical and a generated sweep asserts a non-zero case count.
No existing method's behaviour, signature, or refusal code changes; the pre-existing scope and artifact suites still pass unmodified except where a new capability is added to a frozen list.

New root value exports are transcribed into index-surface.test.ts's hand-written EXPECTED_EXPORTS with the count literal bumped, and fresh pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test exits 0 with any residual red attributed to foreign paths against a recorded merge-base baseline.
taskRails: Additive enumeration only. Do not change, relax, or re-code any existing observer/store method or refusal code; a behaviour change here silently alters every scope observation and artifact receipt already in production.
These are external-effect boundaries: never invoke git through a shell, never accept a free-form command string, and keep every child bounded by maxBuffer, timeout and windowsHide.
A missing directory, an empty listing, and an unreadable entry are three different facts and must carry three different answers; an empty result is never proof of absence.
Tests assert the exact stable reason code and the refusing layer, and any generated sweep asserts it produced a non-zero number of cases.
Target <=250 physical lines per production file and split before 400; this cap is per file, not per task.
reopenReason: Promoting the first prerequisite slice created by the completed SPIDR breakdown of parent task-0325dcf7ee744123b40cf583230c7b6a. It has no hard dependency, owns only the missing Git-ref/artifact-enumeration capabilities, and is file-disjoint from the contract slice; prior architect handoff explicitly identifies it as immediately plan-ready.
